source_name: City of Detroit Office of the Assessor - Parcels (Current), ArcGIS Online (owner topsoil.integration_detroitmi, item 3c784c118e5c4083b37038e9b38573df)
licence: none on dataset (licenseInfo empty); city FOIA page calls portal data 'public domain'
licence_quote: search 100+ open datasets to access free, public domain information about City activities
notes: Dataset item and hub item (9ca25373..., now 'Parcels (Deprecated)') both have empty licenseInfo. Only public-domain statement is generic text on the city's FOIA guidance page; Executive Order 2015-2 (GO DATA) has no licence/reuse wording (Detroitography paraphrases it as placing city data in the public domain). Upgrade to green only if the user accepts the city FOIA-page statement. Layer also carries taxpayer_* fields - do not request them; use outFields=parcel_id,address,zip_code.

source_name: Cook County GIS Dept - parcelHistorical MapServer, Parcel 2025
licence: Cook County GIS Open Data Ordinance (2013) - conditional commercial use
licence_quote: Commercial users are authorized to utilize the Open GIS Data to further their commercial enterprise ... if they are compiling it with other data.

tested.note: envelope -87.79091,41.8955,-87.78849,41.8973 inSR=4326, returnCountOnly; layer polygon, SR 3435

notes: Not an open licence: commercial use is conditional (must be compiled with other data); free use otherwise framed as noncommercial/charitable/educational/research. copyrightText 'Cook County GIS Dept.'. No situs address on the layer (PIN only; address would need a join to Assessor Parcel Universe on datacatalog.cookcountyil.gov, which shows no licence). Same ordinance covers Cook County edge-of-pavement/planimetrics, so those are grey too.

source_name: Nassau County (no public source). NYS ITS NYS_Tax_Parcels_Public excludes Nassau.
licence: NYS layer: disclaimer only, no licence; Nassau: not shared, sold via Tax Map Division
licence_quote: we respect each county's right as the data owner to control the distribution their GIS data

tested.note: NYS public layer returns 0 at Levittown (Nassau not among its 36 counties). gisservices.its.ny.gov copy returned 'Service not started'; nysgeohub.ny.gov copy works.

notes: Nassau is not in the NYS public parcel layer; gis.ny.gov points only to Nassau's Land Records Viewer (lrv.nassaucountyny.gov, which rejected automated access). Tax maps are sold at the Tax Map Division. Even for included counties the NYS layer is disclaimer-only ('The User accepts the Data provided as is') - grey at best. The NYS layer also contains owner/mailing fields - never request them.

source_name: City of Philadelphia Department of Records - DOR_Parcel (OpenDataPhilly)
licence: City of Philadelphia License -> phila.gov terms of use
licence_quote: Commercial use is prohibited without the prior written permission of the City.

tested.note: envelope -75.17607,39.9177,-75.17373,39.9195 inSR=4326, returnCountOnly (works technically, but licence is red)

notes: OpenDataPhilly dataset page lists 'City of Philadelphia License' linking to metadata.phila.gov terms, which point to phila.gov/terms-of-use ('All rights are reserved'). Not usable commercially without written permission. PASDA mirror inherits the same terms. Philadelphia sidewalk/curb planimetrics fall under the same licence -> red.

source_name: Open Data DC - Owner Polygons (Common Ownership Lots), DCGIS Property_and_Land layer 40
licence_quote: This work is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License.
notes: Attribution: District of Columbia (Office of the Chief Technology Officer / Dept of Buildings). Layer has OWNERNAME, CAREOFNAME, ADDRESS1/2, CITYSTZIP and tax fields - request only outFields=SSL,PREMISEADD,UNITNUMBER. Condos not included (OwnerPly excludes condo records). Covers land outside rights-of-way (tax, parcel, reservation, record lots).

source_name: MassGIS - Massachusetts Property Tax Parcels (Level 3), ArcGIS Online item 73d4c766167848b795f1048cad3919c7
licence_quote: Since MassGIS data is paid for by public tax dollars, the data are in the public domain and therefore can be used by anyone for any purpose.
notes: mass.gov returned 403 to WebFetch; FAQ wording confirmed via search snippet of mass.gov FAQ and OSM wiki quoting it. Item licenseInfo itself is only a boundary-accuracy disclaimer. Credit requested: 'MassGIS (Bureau of Geographic Information), Commonwealth of Massachusetts EOTSS'. Old L3_TAXPAR_POLY_ASSESS_gdb URL now returns 'Invalid URL' - use the new service. Owner fields (OWNER1, OWN_ADDR...) present - do not request.

source_name: Franklin County Auditor - Parcel Features, Tax Parcel (hub item 3b1c75018fca40c8b24083fd48197e74 'Parcel Boundaries')
licence: custom disclaimer only (hub licence 'custom'); no public-domain or reuse statement on any parcel item
licence_quote: Users of this data are notified that the primary information source should be consulted for verification
notes: Rechecked: Parcel_Features and Parcel_Features_WebMercator iteminfo licenseInfo empty; hub item licenseInfo is a disclaimer; Auditor 'Disclaimer & Copyright' page has only an as-is/no-liability disclaimer and a '(c) 2026 Franklin County Auditor's Office' footer. No explicit public-domain statement found for parcels. By contrast the Auditor's BaseMap/Reference_Data service IS explicitly CC0 (see sidewalk record) - so the office knows how to mark CC0 and did not mark parcels. Stays grey; ask Auditor GIS to confirm. Owner/mailing fields (OWNERNME*, MAILNME*, PSTL*) present - never request.
